verdict.rationale: Fin.ai documents a dedicated 'Deploy Fin Voice' article, indicating voice/phone channel support alongside chat/email, but the evidence pack gives no detail on speech-in/speech-out mechanics, whether voice sessions share the same knowledge base/actions as chat, or any hands-on validation of call quality or parity with chat capabilities. missing for 10: technical detail on speech recognition/synthesis, confirmation that actions/knowledge are identical across chat and voice, and independent/hands-on evidence of voice call handling.
